item.title: Using the Polaris REST APIs with curl
item.description:
This guide shows how to use the Polaris REST APIs with plain curl, without the Polaris CLI or a query engine. It covers the steps most setups need:

  1. Get an access token.
  2. Create a catalog (Management API).
  3. Create a principal and give it access to the catalog (Management API).
  4. Create namespaces and tables as that principal (Iceberg REST API).
  5. Clean up.

The catalog uses FILE storage inside the Polaris container, so no cloud account or object store is needed. This setup is not intended for production use.
